biggest_catch: Only $70 per referral and capped at $350 per member account during the promo period (5 referrals max) — plus your friend must set up a recurring $300+ direct deposit within 60 days and keep the account open 90 days.
catches: Referrer incentive is $70 per qualifying referral, capped at $350 per member account during the promotional period (5 referrals max)

Friend (referee) must be 18+, a NEW IU Credit Union member (no membership in the preceding 12 months), and open a new household membership (same primary address = one household, limit one bonus per new household)
Friend must open a Membership Savings account ($5 ownership share) plus any eligible checking account
Friend must establish a qualifying recurring direct deposit of $300+ (payroll/government/benefit ACH) within 60 days of account opening — P2P, mobile deposits, and internal transfers do not qualify
Friend's account must stay open at least 90 days or the bonus may be forfeited/reversed; referrer must have an open account when paid
Referrer must be an IU CU member 18+ and not an employee; the refer-a-friend form must identify the referrer at account opening
Promotional period: February 16, 2026 – December 31, 2026; IU CU can modify/terminate at any time (bonuses for completed qualifications honored)
Bonuses/incentives are dividends reported on IRS Form 1099-INT
IU Credit Union field of membership applies (Indiana University community and affiliates)

steps: Be a current IU Credit Union member 18+ (non-employee)
Give your friend the printed Refer-A-Friend form from iucu.org with your name on it
Friend opens a new IU CU household membership (Membership Savings + eligible checking) and identifies you as the referrer at account opening
Friend sets up a recurring qualifying direct deposit of $300+ within 60 days and keeps the account open 90 days
$70 is deposited into your IU CU account after all qualifications are met (cap $350 per member account during the promo period)
timing: Handing over the form + having them name you takes ~5-10 minutes active; your $70 pays after the friend completes the DD and 90-day account-open requirements.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Handing over the form + having them name you takes ~5-10 minutes active; your $70 pays after the friend completes the DD and 90-day account-open requirements. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
Volume constraint noted in terms: capped at $350 per member account during the promotional period (5 referrals max)', — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
